# Acme Widgets

> Acme Widgets is a small HTTP service for creating and shipping widgets. These pages are the example input for llms-txt-gen; run llms-txt-gen generate examples/docs --stdout to see the output.

---

# Authentication

Source: https://acme.example.com/docs/guides/authentication

# Authentication

Every request carries a short-lived token in the Authorization header. Tokens expire after one hour and can be rotated at any time.

---

# Quickstart

Source: https://acme.example.com/docs/guides/quickstart

# Quickstart

Install the client, create a widget, ship it.

---

Source: https://acme.example.com/docs/reference/api

# HTTP API

Every endpoint, with request and response examples.

```http
POST /widgets
```
